name: Griffith Handyman Services
summary: Wix one-page handyman site with strong tool/service imagery and visible contact info, but trust and conversion are weakened by Wix/template branding, a vague hero, buried credibility, task-light service organization, and no clear next-step flow.
angle: Brand-faithful trust cleanup: preserve the dark Wix-style visual language, coral accents, handyman imagery, and simple structure while clarifying hero copy, adding tap-to-call/email CTAs, surfacing since-2014/free-estimate/local trust cues, organizing services by buyer task path, and removing template leftovers.
